doc: Package specifier used for the runtime import emitted into generated output. TypeScript uses the specifier verbatim, Kotlin a dotted package name, Rust a crate name. No default: the consumer's package identity is only known through this define.
Directory the runtime package is emitted into, relative to the output root. '.' emits the runtime beside the generated sources.
Output directory for TypeScript test generation (tscompiler).
Test runner environment for TypeScript test generation (node | deno | bun).
Output directory for Kotlin test generation (kotlincompiler).

Module real of the Haxe Float type for the whole compilation: f64 (default) maps Float to f64/Double/number; f32 maps it to f32/Float and rounds wire reads at the decode point. The TypeScript target rejects f32 at startup. See docs/specs/features/23-float-precision-switch.md.
Whether the compilation writes the package manifest of its output tree: emit (default) or none. See docs/specs/features/24-package-shell.md.
Package name in the emitted manifest; defaults to the neutral value generated.
Package version in the emitted manifest; defaults to 0.1.0.
Optional license string; the license field appears only under this define (Package.swift carries no license field).
Rust only: name:path of one integration test, emitted as a [[test]] block for repositories that keep tests outside the crate.

Whether the compilation packs its output tree into the ecosystem install artifact beside the tree: none (default) or emit. The npm tarball and the Kotlin Maven directory are build output compiled through package-tsc and package-kotlinc; the cargo crate, the Swift zip, and the Pub tar.gz carry source. See docs/specs/features/25-package-artifacts.md.

Path to the TypeScript compiler executable used when package-artifacts=emit on the TypeScript target: the npm artifact ships compiled JavaScript plus declarations, so the pack step runs tsc over a staged copy of the tree.
Path to the kotlinc executable used when package-artifacts=emit on the Kotlin target: the artifact is a Maven repository directory carrying a jar compiled from the generated sources.
Maven groupId of the Kotlin artifact directory, written as the pom groupId and the directory path under maven/; defaults to the package name.
